message_indexes.name: idx_messages_property

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_contact
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_contact ON public.messages USING btree (contact_id) WHERE (contact_id IS NOT NULL)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_conversation
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_conversation ON public.messages USING btree (conversation_id) WHERE (conversation_id IS NOT NULL)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_created
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_created ON public.messages USING btree (created_at DESC)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_external_id
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_external_id ON public.messages USING btree (external_id) WHERE (external_id IS NOT NULL)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_org
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_org ON public.messages USING btree (org_id)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_unread_inbound
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_unread_inbound ON public.messages USING btree (property_id, created_at DESC) WHERE ((direction = 'inbound'::text) AND (read_at IS NULL))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_unknown_active
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_unknown_active ON public.messages USING btree (from_address, created_at DESC) WHERE ((contact_id IS NULL) AND (dismissed_at IS NULL))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_queued_scheduled
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_queued_scheduled ON public.messages USING btree (scheduled_for) WHERE ((status = 'queued'::text) AND (scheduled_for IS NOT NULL))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_inbound_provider_external_unique
message_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_messages_inbound_provider_external_unique ON public.messages USING btree (provider, external_id) WHERE ((direction = 'inbound'::text) AND (external_id IS NOT NULL))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_ai_responder_inbound_unique
message_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_messages_ai_responder_inbound_unique ON public.messages USING btree (((metadata ->> 'inbound_message_id'::text))) WHERE ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (direction = 'outbound'::text) AND ((metadata ->> 'generated_by'::text) = 'ai_responder_v1'::text) AND (metadata ? 'inbound_message_id'::text))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_campaign_property_unique
message_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_messages_campaign_property_unique ON public.messages USING btree (campaign_id, property_id) WHERE ((campaign_id IS NOT NULL) AND (direction = 'outbound'::text))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_campaign_id_status
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_campaign_id_status ON public.messages USING btree (campaign_id, status) WHERE (campaign_id IS NOT NULL)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_attributed_outbound_message_id
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_attributed_outbound_message_id ON public.messages USING btree (attributed_outbound_message_id) WHERE (attributed_outbound_message_id IS NOT NULL)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_inbound_intent_unique
message_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_messages_inbound_intent_unique ON public.messages USING btree (inbound_intent_id) WHERE ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (direction = 'inbound'::text) AND (inbound_intent_id IS NOT NULL))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_campaign_queue_controls
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_campaign_queue_controls ON public.messages USING btree (campaign_id, status, scheduled_for) WHERE ((campaign_id IS NOT NULL) AND (channel = 'sms'::text) AND (direction = 'outbound'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'paused'::text])))

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_property_direction_created
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_property_direction_created ON public.messages USING btree (property_id, direction, created_at DESC) WHERE (property_id IS NOT NULL)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_property_created_id
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_property_created_id ON public.messages USING btree (property_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (property_id IS NOT NULL)

message_indexes.name: idx_messages_sms_inbox_org_conversation_latest
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_sms_inbox_org_conversation_latest ON public.messages USING btree (org_id, conversation_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) INCLUDE (contact_id, property_id, direction, read_at) WHERE ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (contact_id IS NOT NULL) AND (conversation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'paused'::text])))

message_indexes.name: messages_fts_gin
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX messages_fts_gin ON public.messages USING gin (fts)

message_indexes.name: t2_proof_history_idx
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX t2_proof_history_idx ON public.messages USING btree (org_id, conversation_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (channel = 'sms'::text)

message_indexes.name: t2_proof_unread_idx
message_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX t2_proof_unread_idx ON public.messages USING btree (org_id, conversation_id, inbox_inbound_revision, id) WHERE ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (direction = 'inbound'::text) AND (read_at IS NULL))
